name: EveOnion-DailyTweet
description: Tweet the latest EveOnion article from eveonion.com to @EveOnionNews with a punchy satirical headline. Runs daily at 2:30 PM EST.

payload.message:
Post the latest EveOnion article to X and Bluesky with a punchy one-liner.

Execute: python C:\Users\compj\.openclaw\workspace\scripts\eveonion\tweet_latest.py

This script finds the most recent article in eveonion/articles/, extracts the headline, and posts it to both X and Bluesky with the article link.

Report the tweet text, X URL, and Bluesky URL to #eveonion.
